goals.title: Foundation
goals.objective: Build the API client (api.js helpers for ALL backend endpoints in the brief) and a reusable design system in frontend/app/components (Panel, Badge, ProgressBar, MasteryBar, Spinner, EmptyState, ErrorBanner) plus layout/nav/theme. npm run build must pass.
goals.evidence: api.js: API_URL + getJson/postJson/putJson/postForm + api.{} helpers for ALL endpoints; errors carry .status. components/ui.js: Panel, Badge, StatusBadge, ProgressBar, MasteryBar, Spinner, EmptyState, ErrorBanner (hook-free). globals.css design-system styles + responsive. nav adds Reviews. npm run build green, all routes static.

goals.title: Dashboard
goals.objective: Dashboard page: backend health, courses list with generation status + mastery, subjects list, due-reviews summary count; cards link to each course. Bind exact /courses, /subjects, /courses/reviews/due fields. Build green.
goals.evidence: app/page.js: health badge + stat cards (courses/subjects/reviews-due), courses grid with StatusBadge + avgMastery MasteryBar + generation summary (completed/total/failed), subjects list, due-reviews count; cards link to /courses/[id]; binds /courses,/subjects,/courses/reviews/due. Build green.

goals.title: Ingest
goals.objective: Upload page: source ingest (text/markdown/url/youtube) via /upload/source showing rubric_passed/rubric_total + competencies/chapters counts, and PDF upload via /courses/uploads (course) and /upload/pdf (subject); route to created course outline. Build green.
goals.evidence: app/upload/page.js: source ingest (text/markdown/url/youtube) -> /upload/source rendering rubric_passed/rubric_total + chapters/competencies counts; course PDF -> /courses/uploads (multipart files+title) with link to created /courses/[id] outline; subject PDF -> /upload/pdf. Build green.

goals.title: Outline review
goals.objective: Course outline page: render chapters>sections (number,title), edit titles/numbers, PUT /courses/{id}/outline, approve action, show status. Build green.
goals.evidence: app/courses/[id]/page.js Outline panel: renders chapters>sections with editable number+title inputs (round-trips full loaded chapters), Save -> PUT /courses/{id}/outline updates document + shows saved time, StatusBadge for course status, per-section Study links + done badge. Build green.

goals.title: Generate
goals.objective: Generation page/section: POST /courses/{id}/generate, poll GET /courses/{id} for generation {status,total_sections,completed_sections,failed_sections,last_error,next_retry_at}, per-section status list with regenerate. Build green.
goals.evidence: app/courses/[id]/page.js Generation panel: POST /courses/{id}/generate, polls GET /courses/{id} every 2.5s while status in queued/running/retry_scheduled, ProgressBar + completed/total/failed + last_error + next_retry_at, per-section Regenerate -> /sections/{sid}/regenerate. Build green.

goals.title: Section study
goals.objective: Section study page GET /courses/{id}/sections/{sid}: learning_objectives, concepts, lesson_blocks by kind, worked_examples, source_spans, prerequisites + competency mastery. Build green.
goals.evidence: app/courses/[id]/sections/[sid]/page.js GET /courses/{id}/sections/{sid}: renders lesson_goal, learning_objectives, competencies (level badge + MasteryBar), concepts (explanation+source_refs), lesson_blocks grouped by kind (body+source_refs), worked_examples (prompt+steps), source_spans as quoted evidence with page refs, completed badge. Build green.

goals.title: Tutor chat
goals.objective: In-section tutor chat POST /courses/{id}/sections/{sid}/chat {question} rendering answer + support_status badge + source_refs, with persisted chat_history. Build green.
goals.evidence: TutorChat component in section page: POST /courses/{id}/sections/{sid}/chat {question} -> renders answer + SupportBadge (pdf_backed/course_inference/outside_knowledge tones) + source_refs tags; thread seeded from section.chat_history and appends new turns. Build green.

goals.title: Checks and quiz
goals.objective: Understanding checks (answer + confidence 1-6 -> grade -> score/passed/feedback) and mastery quiz submit (answers + confidence -> score/results/feedback) with mastery reflected. Build green.
goals.evidence: Checks: per CheckItem answer (textarea or multiple_choice select on choices) + confidence 1-6 -> POST checks/{cid}/grade -> score/passed/feedback badge; reloads section for mastery update. Quiz: collects answers per mastery_quiz item + confidence -> POST quiz/submit -> score/feedback/results list. Build green.

goals.title: Reviews and polish
goals.objective: Spaced-review page (/courses/reviews/due + per-course, include_upcoming) with next-due cards; responsive + loading/empty/error states across the app; final npm run build + lint clean; final quality gate.
goals.evidence: app/reviews/page.js: GET /courses/reviews/due?include_upcoming with Show-upcoming toggle, due/upcoming grouped cards (course/section context, MasteryBar, reason/next_review_at/last_score), links to /courses/{id}/sections/{sid}, due_count/upcoming_count headers. Polish: loading/empty/error states on every data page, responsive nav, design-system reuse. Post-review fixes: quiz now binds {score,passed,items:[{item_id,score,feedback}]} (was results), section load() clears stale error, dashboard binds the FLAT course summary (mastery_percent/generation_status/generation_completed_sections/generation_total_sections/generation_last_error/competencies_count). Final npm run build green (6 routes).

claudeObjective: Complete all ultragoal stories in .omc/ultragoal/plans/frontend-build/goals.json: G001-foundation Foundation; G002-dashboard Dashboard; G003-ingest Ingest; G004-outline-review Outline review; G005-generate Generate; G006-section-study Section study; G007-tutor-chat Tutor chat; G008-checks-and-quiz Checks and quiz; G009-reviews-and-polish Reviews and polish
